mentions.story: Ask HN: Pros and cons of thinking in public vs. in private?
mentions.why: Talking about intentions early undermines drive to finish
mentions.quote: I did not really put two and two together until I saw this talk[0] many years ago and it clicked.

mentions.author: drakonka
mentions.story: Ask HN: What is the best piece of advice someone has told you?
mentions.why: Telling goals gives an emotional reward and lowers drive
